title: WordPress Core WP_Query SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of WordPress Core. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the WP_Query class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
